_note: Weights are relative — the scorer normalizes them, so they need not sum to 1. Filters are absolute and run BEFORE scoring.
_uncertain_field_note: Which field the Monte Carlo perturbs by each row's confidence. Usually price. Set to null to perturb only the weights.

fx_to_usd._as_of: YYYY-MM-DD — update before trusting absolute figures

stated-goal.label: The user's stated goal
stated-goal.description: Weighted in the order the user stated their priorities.

cheapest.label: Pure cost
cheapest.description: Single-axis extreme. Shows what the balanced model trades away.

reliability-first.label: Reliability above all
reliability-first.description: The opposite extreme. If this and 'cheapest' pick the same candidate, the recommendation is unusually robust.
